channel.title: River 川
channel.description: Short texts by Yoso that move like a quiet river: fragments of a daily practice, read slowly, one after another.

item.title: A quiet sea of abstraction
item.description:
Before reaching the shore,
in the quiet sea of abstraction;
seize the mind.

Yoso

item.title: Submissiveness
item.description:
Submissiveness,
alien to the shining soul,
breathing union is.

Yoso

item.title: Present, mindful now
item.description:
Present, mindful now.
Peaceful heart, a quiet mind.
Harmony’s embrace.

Yoso

item.title: Boundless
item.description:
Hands in prayer,
I bow respectfully to each cell in my body,
and to the life in you.

Yoso

item.title: Wind’s natural soul
item.description:
Wind’s natural soul…
Leading me into the unknown…
Transcendental flow.

Yoso

item.title: First love, then form
item.description:
First love, then form.

Yoso

item.title: To feel with opened eyes
item.description:
To feel with opened eyes,
to listen with the heart,
to speak with truth.

Yoso

item.title: Spring energy
item.description:
Spring energy,
blessing our hearts with auspicious light.
Each blossom, a vow of harmony.
With gratitude, I am humbled by your transience.

Yoso

item.title: Breathe in
item.description:
Breathe in…
Breathe out…
The energy that connects all forms…
Infinite chains of chemical reactions…
Trillions of cells living within…
What am I?

Yoso

item.title: Kind loving love
item.description:
Kind loving love,
Kind loving love,
Kind loving love.

Yoso

item.title: The vow
item.description:
With each blossom,
I vow to dedicate myself to the prosperity and harmony of sentience.

Yoso

item.title: The other
item.description:
Heal yourself to heal others,
heal others to heal yourself.
There is no other.

Yoso

item.title: I surrender to the flow
item.description:
I surrender to the flow…
Reaching the depths of my heart…
Union’s Embrace.

Yoso

item.title: Thank you
item.description:
Thank you for always being by my side.
With you, my heart flows like a tranquil river.

Yoso

item.title: Death is clemency
item.description:
There is no greater shock in life than birth,
unable to survive alone,
we invest in independence.
Death is clemency.

Yoso

item.title: Enduring wisdom
item.description:
Life itself is the knowledge!
Eternal wisdom,
if only we listened.

Yoso

item.title: Flirt
item.description:
Existence itself…
Flirting with death…
There is no presence without breath.

Yoso

item.title: Modern times
item.description:
Scanning for knowledge,
seeking distractions,
fearing impulse.

Yoso

item.title: One
item.description:
Becoming One.
Being One.
All is One.

Yoso

item.title: Do not
item.description:
Do not love Love,
be love,
simply love.

Yoso

item.title: The spring awakes
item.description:
The spring awakens,
golden heart,
pure Consciousness.

Yoso

item.title: Your mind is your home
item.description:
Your mind is your home.
Bring it light,
bring it air,
bring it love,
bring it you.

Yoso

item.title: A voice
item.description:
Finally, a voice.
All is light,
To those who awake.

Yoso

item.title: Do not judge
item.description:
Do not judge your experiences,
union of presence, past and future;
All there is is now.

Yoso

item.title: What is the time
item.description:
There is a time in the day,
when the sun watches the moon;
What is the time?

Yoso

item.title: Above knowledge
item.description:
Above knowledge, integrity,
beyond judgement,
awakening.

Yoso

item.title: Fragments
item.description:
Fragments of consciousness?
Breathing harmony.

Yoso

item.title: Shadows
item.description:
The light reveals the shadows of the ego.

Yoso

item.title: Mind the gap
item.description:
The space between thoughts,
the gap between each breath.
Closer to death.

Yoso

item.title: The bow
item.description:
The gift of essence,
that honours your presence.

Yoso

item.title: Harvest moon
item.description:
Harvest moon,
bright in the East,
before dawn, a cold wind.

Yoso

item.title: Intention
item.description:
Cultivate intention,
as seeds that feed your imagination.

Yoso
